newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues term tender to buy 1.08 mln T diesel.
newsitem.headline: India issues term tender to buy 1.08 mln T diesel.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy up to 1.08 million tonnes of diesel on term for delivery between August 1997 and March 1998, industry sources said on Tuesday.

The eight-month term tender seeks up to two 40,000-45,000 tonnes cargo of 1.0 percent sulphur grade diesel per month, each for delivery to Kandla on the west coast and to Madras or Haldia on the east coast.
IOC also seeks to import a 40,000-45,000 tonne cargo of 0.5 percent sulphur grade diesel for delivery to Madras, Haldia or to Paradeep on the east coast.
The tender closes July 2 and is valid until July 6.
Industry sources said IOC has issued the term tender in place of a spot tender for August.
IOC bought 855,000 tonnes of diesel in 19 cargoes in its July tender.
